The '''father''' of [[Jhaka Bakarn]]<ref name="Codex" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] several generations before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A member of the prestigious [[Bakarn family|Bakvalen family]], the Bakvalen patriarch was furious when his eldest daughter Jhaka turned her back on her life as a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] noble and joined the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Her father disowned her, leading Jhaka to change her surname to the more common "Bakarn," and the man's daughter went on to become a renowned fighter ace. When Jhaka was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in battle against a [[Unidentified warlord (Jhaka Bakarn)|dangerous warlord]], her father was overcome with pride and grief, and he changed the family's name to Bakarn in her honor.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jhaka Bakarn's father was mentioned in the Codex entry for the Bakvalen family in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
